provenance_note: Context-independent DddA radial-nucleosome likelihoods (2026-09-29). Each state keeps the SsDddA-site-weighted mean of the previous table (legacy/ddda_nuc_refine_context_v2.6.json): P(hit|protected) = 1.91e-06, P(hit|accessible) = 0.6370, weighted by target counts in NAPA and UBA1 scDAF-seq. The previous per-context pattern did not track observed SsDddA context rates (Spearman -0.11/-0.14); flattening it kept 97% of bases in the same nucleosome state at both amplicons. Transitions and start probabilities are unchanged.
